findings.title: Existing RECREATE exit code silently changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE was 4 and is now 3, while the new FEATURE_DISABLED takes the value 4. The update-compatibility exit codes are a documented contract for CI/CD and operator scripts (the guide's exit-code table lists 3 as 'not possible, must shut down'). Any automation already written against the old value 4 for 'recreate required' will now interpret a recreate upgrade as a feature-disabled error, and a feature-disabled run will be read as a recreate upgrade. The renumbering is not called out in the PR and no migration note exists. Keep RECREATE at 4 and assign the new code a fresh value, or document the break explicitly.

findings.title: Null-strategy deployment returns before enabling the rolling-updates feature
findings.body: In createInitialDeployment, when updateStrategy is null the method returns at line 106 before the FeatureSpec with ROLLING_UPDATES is set. The PR docs state that the Operator fails if rolling-updates is not enabled while the feature is in preview. So the upgradeStrategy() null-case parameterizations of testImageChange and testCacheMaxCount run without the feature and will fail or test the wrong behavior. The feature enablement should happen for all cases, before the early return.
